title: US airstrike hits wedding in southern Iran, kills 4 including child
text:
US airstrike hits wedding in southern Iran, kills 4 including child"

"🔆🔅More footage of US airstrike on a residential home hosting a wedding celebration in Bandar Kohestak, Sirik County, on Tuesday night, killing four civilians and wounding at least 68 others."

"Among the dead were two women and two children—including four-year-old Amirali Karimi, whose name has become a symbol of the tragedy. The attack, which Iran has condemned as a "war crime," turned a night of celebration into one of mourning.
